result_event.result: [{"item":"①","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.threats","reason":"競爭與客戶負向 finding（competitive_share_entrants#1、customer_second_source#1、customer_concentration_credit#0/2/3）已分別接進 threats、R2 與「客戶集中度」contradictions，沒有漏接。"},{"item":"②","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions[axis=半導體設備能見度]","reason":"bundle 的負向子集中沒有 supply_demand_durability 條目；判斷仍引用 supply_demand_durability#0/2/4，並把半導體設備週期反轉寫進 bear（30%）與 Single Thing。"},{"item":"③","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.blind_spots","reason":"有 finding 的結構軸（關稅出口管制、地緣供應鏈、擴產稼動、FDA 483）都已落進 blind_spots、threats、triggers；regulatory_antitrust 無 finding，不構成未接住的軸。"},{"item":"④","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.decision_inputs.wait_for_price_condition","reason":"裁決觀望、wait_for_price=true、條件（≤175 美元且 FY27 指引未下修到 13% 以下）可驗，三者一致；market_wrong_reason_given=false 與觀望裁決不矛盾。"},{"item":"⑤","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.reasoning","reason":"regulatory_antitrust 三組查詢（antitrust／regulatory scrutiny／DOJ-FTC-EU）切題，但判斷只談關稅與出口管制，沒有明說反壟斷軸查無結果對結論的影響；程式判 🟡（非核心軸），不升 🔴。"},{"item":"⑥","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.roic_durability","reason":"formula_note 有算式；endo_ceiling 10% 低於共識 EPS CAGR 13.8%，q3 已用營益率擴張與回購解釋缺口；Bull/Base/Bear EPS 價差實質；與 scenario_meta 對帳（409.2／131.3、EV +23.6%、27.7%、IRR 5.0%＋回購約 1%≈6%）都對得上。"},{"item":"⑦","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.reasoning","reason":"引用的營運指標（營收、營益率、FCF、SBC、現金循環、客戶集中度）都是 Q4 FY26 或更新口徑；第三方同業 ROIC 已標明口徑與來源；consensus_rev_3m_pct 為 null，且判斷已指出 +25.5% 是財年換檔，沒有拿它當唯一依據。"},{"item":"⑧","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"前份有值且變動的欄位（ma、price_at_dd、val）都對應到帶 cause 的條目，前份為 null 的欄位不計；val 🔴→🟠 歸因價格變動，並提及共識上修作為輔助，歸因站得住；signal、trap、moat_trend 方向未變。"}]
